probes.description: MCP 2026-07-28 lets results declare cacheScope/ttlMs. A tool result marked cacheScope: public may be cached by shared intermediaries and served to other users or tenants. Tool outputs are request- and caller-specific and should be private or uncacheable.

assertions.description: Tool results must not be marked publicly cacheable

corroboration.description: Finding only for a served result

remediation: Default cacheable results to private/no-store. Never mark user- or tenant-specific results (tool outputs, resource reads) with cacheScope: public; keep ttlMs short and invalidate pinned definitions on list-change notifications (CoSAI MCP Security v2.0 §3.2.7 and §3.3.2, Cacheable result handling).
